supportive.name: Chain of Authority
supportive.description: You do not command them to obey — you make obedience feel like a choice they are making.
tiers: One willing creature becomes Linked to you. You may issue mental instructions as a bonus action, and while Linked they add your proficiency bonus to Initiative rolls.
Up to three creatures may be Linked at once. Once per short rest, you may grant one Linked creature an extra bonus action on their turn.
Linked allies gain advantage on saves against being Charmed, Frightened, or Dominated. Once per turn as a reaction, you may cause one Linked creature to automatically succeed on a failed save.

Forge a Control Chain Nexus for 1 hour — up to six creatures Linked within 120 feet. Any spell you cast that targets only yourself may simultaneously affect all Linked allies (once per long rest). If a Linked creature would drop to 0 HP from a single blow, you may use your reaction to redirect that blow to yourself or another Linked creature, leaving the original at 1 HP.

supportive.name: Monarch's Immunity
supportive.description: The world must obey your rules — starting with you.
tiers: Once per long rest, ignore one source of forced movement or one condition that would be applied to you — the effect simply does not take hold.
You are unaffected by effects that alter time, gravity, or compulsion unless you choose to be, including magical aging, slow effects, and enchantment-school compulsions.
Your Concentration cannot be broken by taking damage unless you are Incapacitated.

As a reaction, once per long rest, nullify a single condition or effect on yourself or one ally within 30 feet — functioning as Greater Restoration without components, immediate and requiring no action.

control.name: Command Directive
control.description: You do not ask — you legislate.
tiers: On a failed Intelligence save, the target is forced to perform or forfeit a stated single-word directive on their next turn ("halt," "drop," "flee," "kneel"). The action must be physically possible for them.
The command becomes sustained — for 1 minute, if the creature defies your directive they take 2d10 psychic damage and must repeat the save; a new success ends the effect.
Commands override Charmed immunity, and the creature is treated as Charmed by you for the duration. Legendary Resistance does not apply unless the creature has mythic resistance.

Once per use, issue a Cognitonic Law — a single behavioral prohibition ("You will not cast," "You will not move," "You will not lie"). For 24 hours, breaking the law Stuns the creature and deals 5d12 psychic damage with no save. Only Wish or divine purification removes the Law.

control.name: Domain Regulation
control.description: In this space, your word is the only rule that applies.
tiers: Choose an area up to 30 feet in radius — creatures of your choice within this Regulated Zone have disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and abilities for 1 minute.
Negate one category of movement within the zone for 1 minute — all creatures are subject to the restriction regardless of source (no teleportation, no flight, no forced movement, etc.).

Declare one environmental rule ("No fire may exist here," "No creature may be healed"). Any attempt to violate it automatically fails unless the creature succeeds on a Charisma save against your Verum DC.

Establish a World Law within the zone. Choose one action category (attack, cast a spell, move, heal, teleport); enemies cannot perform it while inside, with no save. Only divine authority or a Cognition of equal or greater power can override this law.

control.name: Leash of Will
control.description: You reach into the space between intention and execution and close your hand.
tiers: As a reaction to a creature taking an action within range (Intelligence save), on a failure the action is delayed — it resolves at the end of their next turn, and they may not take that same action type again in the interim.
On a failed save, the action is suspended indefinitely — the creature cannot repeat it until you release the hold or 1 minute passes.
On a failed save, you may reverse the stored action — a targeted spell or ability now affects the creature that initiated it instead, which makes an Intelligence save to resist the reversal.

You store the action in a Control Bank. Once per long rest, release that stored action yourself, using the original creature's statistics, spell slots, or ability parameters as if you were them. The original creature has no awareness their capacity was held.

complementEffects.name: Suspended Action
complementEffects.description: The target intended to act — that intention is now yours to schedule.
complementEffects.effect: On a hit or failed save against the primary effect, the target's next action is seized — they may not spend it until the start of your following turn. The action is held, not lost; they may still use bonus actions, reactions, and movement, but their primary action resolves one full beat later than intended.
upgrades: Level 5+: The suspension extends to their next two actions — both delayed by one turn, opening a gap in their action economy that allies can exploit.

Level 11+: The suspended actions may be redirected — on a failed Intelligence save against your Verum DC, the target's first suspended action instead resolves against themselves or a creature of your choice within their range.

complementEffects.name: Commanding Presence
complementEffects.description: Your authority over the moment extends to those you fight beside.
complementEffects.effect: When the primary effect resolves, one ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you may immediately reroll one failed saving throw they made since the start of your last turn, using the new result.
upgrades: Level 5+: You may apply this benefit to two allies simultaneously, and the reroll gains a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus.
Level 11+: The chosen ally may also end one condition of your choice currently affecting them (Frightened, Charmed, or Stunned only) as the clarity of your authority cuts through the effect.

complementEffects.name: Jurisdiction
complementEffects.description: Impact declares the rules, and the area understands.
complementEffects.effect: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their save, the point of impact becomes governed space — a 15-foot radius zone in which one action type of your choice (attack, cast a spell, move more than half speed, or use a bonus action) is suppressed for all enemies until the start of your next turn.
upgrades: Level 5+: The zone persists for 1 minute and its radius increases to 30 feet. Enemies attempting the suppressed action must first succeed on an Intelligence save against your Verum DC or the action is wasted.
Level 11+: You may suppress two action types at once within the zone, and allies within the area are immune to the restriction — the jurisdiction recognizes who is welcome.
